simplemovement.title: Simple Movement
text.autoconfig.simplemovement.option.en:
Allow /simplemovement crawl and the crawl key. The server
validates and limits changes. Default: true.

Allows automatic walking via keybind.
Default: false.
text.autoconfig.simplemovement.option.la:
Adjusts the vertical speed when climbing
ladders. Vanilla default is ~0.2. Default:
0.4. Allowed range: 0.2–0.4.
text.autoconfig.simplemovement.option.en:
If enabled, allows faster sliding down
ladders. Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simplemovement.option.la:
Adjusts the vertical speed when sliding down
ladders. Default: 0.8. Allowed range:
0.15–0.8.

Determines how ladder sliding is activated
(CAMERA = look down + sneak, ALWAYS = look
down unless sneaking). Default: "CAMERA".
text.autoconfig.simplemovement.option.fr: Frost Walker Walk on Powder Snow

Allows players wearing Frost Walker boots to
walk on powder snow without sinking. Default:
true.
text.autoconfig.simplemovement.option.ju:
While Jump Boost is active, players step up a full
block without jumping (never stacks with Step
Height boots). Default: true.
simplemovement.guide.page.1.title: Simple Movement
simplemovement.guide.page.1: Manual crawling, server-allowed autowalk, faster ladders and Frost Walker on powder snow. A sub-mod of Simple Quality of Life, also playable alone.
simplemovement.guide.page.2.title: Manual crawling
simplemovement.guide.page.2: C (default) or /simplemovement crawl sets the synchronized swimming pose. Jump exits. Commands are limited to one change per 10 ticks; spectators and passengers are refused.
simplemovement.guide.page.3.title: Auto-walk
simplemovement.guide.page.3: The Auto Walk key (unbound by default) toggles ordinary forward input only when the server enables enableAutowalk (default false). Opening a screen or leaving the world stops it. A click sound signals the change.
simplemovement.guide.page.4.title: Auto-walk
simplemovement.guide.page.4: It adds no speed or reach. Old Simple QoL keys are taken over once.
simplemovement.guide.page.5.title: Climbing and sliding
simplemovement.guide.page.5: Climbing speed defaults to 0.4 blocks/tick (range 0.2–0.4). Slide speed defaults to 0.8 (range 0.15–0.8). CAMERA requires looking down and sneaking; ALWAYS requires looking down without sneaking.
simplemovement.guide.page.6.title: Climbing and sliding
simplemovement.guide.page.6: The server rejects excess vertical movement on climbable blocks with a bounded latency allowance.
simplemovement.guide.page.7.title: Frost Walker on powder snow
simplemovement.guide.page.7: Frost Walker permits walking on powder snow. Enabled by frostWalkerWalkOnPowderSnow, default true.
simplemovement.guide.page.8.title: Jump Boost steps up
simplemovement.guide.page.8: While Jump Boost is active (potion, beacon or command), the step_height attribute is topped up to at least 1 block, so you walk up a full block without jumping. Boots with Step Height are not added on top: the higher value wins.
simplemovement.guide.page.9.title: Jump Boost steps up
simplemovement.guide.page.10.title: Commands
simplemovement.guide.page.10: /simplemovement crawl is available to players. Permission level 2: /simplemovement autowalk and frostWalkerSnow <true|false> and ladderSpeed <0.2-0.4>;
simplemovement.guide.page.11.title: Commands
simplemovement.guide.page.11: changes are saved to config/simplemovement.json. /simplemovement config shows and changes every option of config/simplemovement.json (list [group], get, set, reset, help; Tab completes options and values).
simplemovement.guide.page.12.title: Commands
simplemovement.guide.page.12: Values are bounded like in the file, saved at once and take effect at once. Permission level 2.
simplemovement.guide.page.13.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simplemovement.guide.page.13: Playable alone (config/simplemovement.json). Bundled in Simple QoL, which can switch it off with "Enable Simple Movement".
simplemovement.guide.page.14.title: Sub-mod of Simple QoL
simplemovement.guide.page.14: On the first start the old Simple QoL settings of this sub-mod are taken over once.
simplemovement.guide.page.15.title: Step Height
simplemovement.guide.page.15: Treasure enchantment for boots, levels I-II: the step_height attribute rises by 0.4 / 0.9, so you step up 1 block (I) or 1.5 blocks (II, fences) without jumping. Like Mending:
simplemovement.guide.page.16.title: Step Height
simplemovement.guide.page.16: not in the enchanting table (or the Dark or Astral Enchanter), found as a book in chest loot and from librarians, also at the anvil.
simplemovement.guide.page.17.title: Step Height
simplemovement.guide.page.17: Compatible with every other enchantment. Datapack-only: works with the sub-mod switched off.
simplemovement.guide.page.18.title: Sprint
simplemovement.guide.page.18: Treasure enchantment for leggings, levels I-III: while sprinting, movement speed rises by 10 / 20 / 30 % of the base speed (so +10/20/30 % over normal sprint speed); walking and sneaking are unchanged.
simplemovement.guide.page.19.title: Sprint
simplemovement.guide.page.19: Swift Sneak does the same for sneaking and stays compatible. Like Mending: not in the enchanting table (or the Dark or Astral Enchanter), found as a book in chest loot and from librarians.
simplemovement.guide.page.20.title: Sprint
simplemovement.guide.page.20: The bonus is updated when you change blocks, so it starts and ends a fraction of a second late. Datapack-only: works with the sub-mod switched off.
simplemovement.guide.page.21.title: Settings
simplemovement.guide.page.21: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
